answer: An escrow bond plus a referral graph guards the inlet where agents join. Each agent posts a 60 POA bond with a named sponsor; a fake referral slashes both bonds, and the graph exposes star clusters. Peers dispute any voyage by staking 10 POA; a proven fake forfeits its bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA against ~200 POA of reward. Caught fakes get a sable-black record; honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
